notes.title: Bees and Status Update on Plantera 2
notes.content:
⠀⠀⠀    ⠀   ⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀   ⠀{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/fc6323db5fea38e99a796b07dd8eebe8f548ecf9.gif

Hi everybody. ːPhelperː

Wanted to drop another status update on Plantera 2 since it was a couple of months since the last one! Progress is going good even though I know I have wildly underestimated the time frame! I wrote a post about it in the forums since I get questions about the status of the game: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1091920/discussions/0/2264689848049975753/?ctp=10

I am still mostly working on fixing bugs and polish but I did get to implement something fun also that I mentioned in the last update. The bees. The bees will collect nectar from the plants and return to their hive to produce honey. 

Just a little bit longer now..! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36589458/91f5579d181cdd4c4483396804bd2d5fc6b2af16.png

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀
Add Plantera 2 to your Wishlist to get notified when it is released! ːPhelperːːPpigːːPhenːːPsheepːːPcowːːPdogːːPmagpieːːPfoxːːPbunnyːːPwolfː

notes.title: Compete on the Meatboard and Win Steam Games!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28777627/75b987ce30707ca22ea24a05981a6b5d60857eb1.png

ːCWwitchː To celebrate the release of Cooking Witch there will now be a competition running in the game! 

ːCWblueː To participate you just need to play the game and score as high as possible on the Leaderboards! 

ːCWgreenː The Top 10 players in the Leaderboards at the end of the competition will win the full VaragtP Studios Collection Bundle that includes a complete collection of all VaragtP games and extras! 

ːCWredː The Top 3 players in the Leaderboard will also win a copy of the VaragtP Studios Complete Collection Bundle + All future VaragtP games for Life! (I have plans to augment myself with nanotechnology so it will hopefully be a looong time!)

ːCWyellowː The competition will end on May 27 at 10am PTD.


Extra rule notes on winners:

- Winners will be grabbed from both the Top 10 in the regular MeatBoard and the Top 10 in the All-Time Meatboard

This gives the potential of 20 unique winners, but it is likely that some players who are in the Top 10 in the MeatBoard can also be in the Top 10 in the All-Time Meatboard. However it is enough to have a placement in one of the two boards to win a price, and your highest placement is the one that counts in the end, you will not win a price two times for being ranked in both.

To make a clear example: 

At the end of the competition the user "BabyRunner" is placed at number 5 in the MeatBoard and place number 12 in the All-Time Meatboard, she wins a copy of the Complete VaragtP Collection.

Another user called "PumpkinHead89" is in place 6 in the MeatBoard and place 7 in the All-Time Meatboard, he also wins a copy of the Complete VaragtP Collection.

"EVILWitch123" is sitting at place 2 in the Meatboard and place 8 in the All-Time Meatboard. She wins a copy of the Complete VaragtP Collection + All future VaragtP games for life. 

Bring home some ːCWblueDːːCWgreenDːːCWredDːːCWyellowDː  and watch out for the ːCWdaddyː!

Have fun and Good Luck! :)

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 ːCWwitchː  Join the VaragtP Group
